summary: Download All Generic Tool Item Attachments
description: Downloads all of the generic tool item's prostore-file attachments as a single zip. Creates an asynchronous zip manifest server-side and 302 redirects to the streaming URL for the resulting zip. Responds with 422 when the item has fewer than 2 prostore-file attachments. PDM (document_management_document_revision) attachments are not currently included in the resulting zip.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the Generic Tool Item

parameters.name: generic_tool_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the Generic Tool

302.description: Redirect to the streaming URL for the zip download

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - fewer than 2 prostore-file attachments
